business_snapshot: Incorporated in 1984, Shivalik Bimetal Control Ltd. manufactures thermostatic bimetal/trimetal strips, components, shunt resistors, and clad metals. It operates as an end-to-end precision materials manufacturer serving global OEMs and Tier-1s across automotive, smart meters, switchgear, and energy-storage systems.
trajectory_summary: Topline and earnings have compounded across multi-year periods supported by rising demand for shunt resistors and global export expansion, though margins experienced some cyclical compression during FY25 before rebounding strongly in early FY27. Asset base scaling is underway with new capacities in Pune for cell connecting systems and bus bar assemblies, enhancing the value-added product mix.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_narrative: Management highlighted a strong start to FY27, reporting robust growth driven by shunt resurgence in the Americas and scaling of the precision components and assemblies platform.
narrative_vs_numbers.actual_numbers_delivered: Consolidated revenue grew 33.4% YoY to ₹182.2 Cr, EBITDA increased 35.2% to ₹43.2 Cr, and PAT grew 44.9% to ₹33.0 Cr.
narrative_vs_numbers.verbatim_quote: Consolidated revenue grew 33.4% year-on-year to 182.2 crores, EBITDA increased 35.2 to 43.2 crores, and PAT grew 44.9% to 33 crores.
narrative_vs_numbers.source_citation: Q1FY27 Earnings Webinar Transcript, Opening Remarks

cash_quality.cfo_to_pat_ratio_3yr: Cumulative Operating Cash Flow over Mar 2024 to Mar 2026 stands at ₹69 Cr (FY24) + ₹94 Cr (FY25) + ₹55 Cr (FY26) = ₹218 Cr against cumulative PAT of ₹84 Cr + ₹77 Cr + ₹96 Cr = ₹257 Cr, indicating strong 84.8% conversion.
cash_quality.working_capital_trend: Debtor days stood at 82, 80, and 99 days across Mar 2024, Mar 2025, and Mar 2026 respectively. Inventory days remained stable around 165 to 179 days, resulting in a persistent working capital cycle near 197 to 213 days.
cash_quality.leverage_and_roce: Borrowings increased from ₹42 Cr in Mar 2025 to ₹71 Cr in Mar 2026. ROCE remained robust at 33% in Mar 2024, 26% in Mar 2025, and 27% in Mar 2026.
cash_quality.diagnostic_verdict: Accounting profits convert reliably into operational cash flow backed by solid cumulative CFO generation across multi-year cycles, though working capital intensity remains elevated due to lengthy inventory conversion cycles.
cash_quality.verbatim_quote: Cash from Operating Activity: Mar 2024: 69, Mar 2025: 94, Mar 2026: 55
